meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Да это не воровство, послушай! Это абсолютно безопасно.
examples.trans: That's not stealing, listen! It's completely safe.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'water' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Vanya, the water! There's water everywhere!

meanings.note: возвращаться домой = to come back home; к + dative = to someone

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.en: мне горько = I feel bitter, I'm hurt

examples.text: Мне горько, мне плохо. У меня сердце.
examples.trans: I feel bitter, I feel awful. I have a bad heart.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Я делаю всё точно по вашему заказу.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

meanings.en: (colloquial) to lecture, to try to talk round
meanings.note: не надо меня лечить = don't lecture me

examples.trans: This doctor treats patients very well.

examples.text: Не надо меня лечить, хорошо? Я своё решение принял.
examples.trans: Don't lecture me, alright? I've made my decision.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!

meanings.note: Что ты натворил? = What have you done?

examples.trans: Look at what they've done here!

examples.text: Что ты натворил? — Марина, он врёт, он симулянт!

examples.trans: Why is the little girl crying?

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.
examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.
examples.trans: I want to work as a cook in a restaurant.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'держка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'support, backing' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: There you go! No support at all!
I really need the family's support.

поступить.gloss: to enter, to get into (a university); to act

examples.trans: Yulia needs to get into university.

examples.text: Вы плохо поступили, но хотя бы совесть есть.
examples.trans: You acted badly, but at least you have a conscience.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!

short form: ты прав = you're right

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'спокоиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to calm down', paired with 'успокаиваться'.

examples.trans: You are a good woman. Cold.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
